commit.message:
[MOS] Recompute loop liveness after copy forwarding (#578)

* [MOS] Do not coalesce two rotate-referenced values into the A-only Ac class

The register coalescer can merge two shift/rotate-referenced values
into the A-only Ac class. ASL/LSR/ROL/ROR only operate on the
accumulator, so an Ac value is pinned to A for its whole live range;
when the value is also loop-carried across an inner conditional whose
other arm needs A (an inlined CRC16 bit loop: the bit-15 test reloads
the pre-rotate byte into A while the rotated high byte must survive to
the next iteration), removing the COPY strands the live value in Y and
the back-edge ROL reads a stale A — a silent miscompile that both
-verify-machineinstrs and -verify-coalescing accept.

MOSRegisterInfo::shouldCoalesce now refuses the join when the resulting
class is Ac and both operands are referenced by a shift/rotate, keeping
the COPY so the value can occupy the broader AImag8/AY class and vacate
A when needed. This mirrors the existing rotate guards in the same
function (those are performance guards; this one is correctness).

Note the guard removes the trigger — the join that creates the pinned
loop-carried range — not the downstream register-allocator behavior
that produced the stale-A code from verifier-clean MIR; that is
tracked separately.

Two tests: the -run-pass=register-coalescer test pins the shape (two
ROL results connected by an ac COPY must not be coalesced; fails
before the fix, passes after), and coalesce-rotate-ac-no-pessimize.ll
pins the cost side (common straight-line shift chains keep their tight
asl/rol form — the preserved COPY is allocated to A and folds away).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,75 @@
+# RUN: llc -mtriple=mos -run-pass=mos-copy-opt -verify-machineinstrs -o - %s | FileCheck %s
+# RUN: llc -mtriple=mos -mcpu=mos6502 -start-before=mos-copy-opt -verify-machineinstrs -o - %s | FileCheck %s --check-prefix=ASM
+
+# A dead copy in a successor can make a copy in its predecessor dead as well.
+# Both must go in one run: the successor is cleaned first (post-order) and its
+# live-ins shrink before the predecessor's dead flags are computed. Forwarding
+# cannot remove the chain on its own because $a is clobbered in between.
+---
+name: dead_copy_chain
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  ; CHECK-LABEL: name: dead_copy_chain
+  ; CHECK: bb.0.entry:
+  ; CHECK-NOT: COPY
+  ; CHECK: $a = LDImm 5
+  ; CHECK: bb.1:
+  ; CHECK-NOT: COPY
+  ; CHECK: RTS
+  bb.0.entry:
+    liveins: $a
+    $x = COPY $a
+    $a = LDImm 5
+    BRA %bb.1
+
+  bb.1:
+    liveins: $a, $x
+    $y = COPY $x
+    RTS implicit $a
+...
+
+# Propagate dead-copy removal through two predecessors. Clobbering each source
+# prevents forwarding from bypassing the chain. Check the final assembly too:
+# dead-copy chains must not leave register transfers behind.
+---
+name: dead_copy_chain_three_blocks
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  ; CHECK-LABEL: name: dead_copy_chain_three_blocks
+  ; CHECK: bb.0:
+  ; CHECK-NOT: COPY
+  ; CHECK: $a = LDImm 5
+  ; CHECK-NOT: COPY
+  ; CHECK: bb.1:
+  ; CHECK-NOT: COPY
+  ; CHECK: $x = LDImm 6
+  ; CHECK-NOT: COPY
+  ; CHECK: bb.2:
+  ; CHECK-NOT: COPY
+  ; CHECK: RTS
+  ; CHECK-NOT: COPY
+  ; ASM-LABEL: dead_copy_chain_three_blocks:
+  ; ASM-NOT: {{^[ \t]+[a-z]}}
+  ; ASM: lda #5
+  ; ASM-NOT: {{^[ \t]+[a-z]}}
+  ; ASM: ldx #6
+  ; ASM-NOT: {{^[ \t]+[a-z]}}
+  ; ASM: rts
+  ; ASM-NOT: {{^[ \t]+[a-z]}}
+  bb.0:
+    liveins: $a
+    $x = COPY $a
+    $a = LDImm 5
+    BRA %bb.1
+
+  bb.1:
+    liveins: $a, $x
+    $y = COPY $x
+    $x = LDImm 6
+    BRA %bb.2
+
+  bb.2:
+    liveins: $a, $x, $y
+    $rc3 = COPY $y
+    RTS implicit $a, implicit $x
+...

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+# RUN: llc -mtriple=mos -mcpu=mosw65816 -run-pass=mos-copy-opt -verify-machineinstrs -o - %s | FileCheck %s --check-prefix=COPY
+# RUN: llc -mtriple=mos -mcpu=mosw65816 -run-pass=mos-copy-opt,postrapseudos,mos-late-opt -verify-machineinstrs -o - %s | FileCheck %s --check-prefix=LOWER
+
+# Forwarding the loop header's A = COPY Y makes A live across the latch.
+# The sign test must not clobber A after its new value is copied to Y.
+---
+name: copy_forward_loop
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  bb.0.entry:
+    liveins: $a, $x, $rc28
+    $y = COPY $a
+    BRA %bb.1
+
+  bb.1:
+    liveins: $x, $y, $rc28
+    ; COPY-LABEL: bb.1:
+    ; COPY: liveins: {{.*}}$a{{.*}}
+    ; COPY: $rc2 = COPY $a
+    ; COPY: $a, dead $c = ROL
+    ; LOWER-LABEL: bb.1:
+    ; LOWER: $a, dead $c = ROL
+    ; LOWER-NOT: $a = LDImag8 $rc2
+    ; LOWER: BR %bb.3
+    $a = COPY $y
+    $rc2 = COPY $y
+    $rc28, $c = ASL $rc28
+    $a, dead $c = ROL $a, $c
+    $y = COPY $a
+    CmpBrZero %bb.3, undef $n, 0, $rc2, implicit-def $c
+
+  bb.2:
+    liveins: $x, $y, $rc28
+    $a = COPY $rc28
+    $a = EORImm $a, 33
+    $rc28 = COPY $a
+    $a = COPY $y
+    $a = EORImm $a, 16
+    $y = COPY $a
+    BRA %bb.3
+
+  bb.3:
+    liveins: $x, $y, $rc28
+    ; COPY-LABEL: bb.3:
+    ; COPY: liveins: {{.*}}$a{{.*}}
+    $x = DEC $x
+    CmpBrZero %bb.1, undef $z, 0, $x, implicit-def dead $c
+
+  bb.4:
+    liveins: $y, $rc28
+    RTS implicit $y, implicit $rc28
+...
